name: unknown-brand-abstention
comment: The abstention story, structurally: an UrbanStride ad (2000005) hits a shopper with no history of the brand. No belief node -> trust_belief null; no paths -> motifs empty; no awareness, no adstock, no reference price. Gated appraisal must produce engagement ~ 0 (F2/F6), never hallucinated familiarity.
